name: Cedwyn version manifest
about: Read by /_cedwyn/version-gate.js; spec docs/VERSION-STANDARD.md; schema /_cedwyn/version-manifest.schema.json; checked by tools/version_audit.py. Prices are computed, never typed per version: the latest version costs the item's current price, each earlier one £4.99 less per step back (never below £0), v0.0.1 always free. Page counts, dates and changes come from data/ebooks.json and the e-book archive.
